# Pull Request

## Summary

What does this change do and why? One short paragraph.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or CI
- [ ] Chore / tooling

## Linked issues

Closes #

## Screenshots or terminal output

If applicable, paste screenshots of the UI or terminal output that shows the change working.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The commit subjects follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] I have run `pytest tests/ -v` locally and it passes.
- [ ] I have run `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` and they pass.
- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]` if the change is user-visible.
- [ ] I have updated documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`) where needed.
- [ ] I have not committed any secrets (no `.env`, no real API keys).
